per_repetition.backlog_definition: B(t)=actual host send-start submissions minus successful recorded completions; not scheduled arrivals or worker ACKs.
per_repetition.service_demand_backlog_definition: Sum full standalone s0 of each submitted, not-yet-completed request; standalone service-seconds, not remaining GPU work.
per_repetition.peak_interval: entire observed cohort including bounded drain; measurement-only peaks also saved
per_repetition.end_definition: value at measurement window end; separate final values are after drain
per_repetition.tail_slope_definition: OLS slope of exact-time-integrated B bin means over final configured fraction; descriptive trend, not a performance predictor.
per_repetition.queue_episode_definition: Warning requires both a configured absolute count and fraction of offered requests above the queue-wait threshold; it does not assert these observations are contiguous.
per_repetition.clock: same-run perf_counter_ns; no cross-clock timestamp subtraction
